claims.statement: The push-blocking guide applies only to FPT and GHEC. Web-based email privacy and command-line push blocking are separate optional selections; no GHES support is supplied by this page.

When the blocking setting is enabled GitHub checks the most recent commit on each push; if its author email is a private email on the user's account, the push is blocked with a warning. The documented predicate is not every commit, committer email or arbitrary sensitive content.

The settings includes open Settings and Emails, select web-operation email privacy, then select command-line push exposure blocking. Selection alone does not demonstrate native blocking behavior or correct local Git email.

The most-recent-author-email limitation requires a separate full-history exposure assessment; a clean latest commit cannot certify older commits contain no personal email. This is a proposed verification distinction, not a tested bypass claim.
The linked email reference is reviewed separately. No setting is enabled, push attempted, email exposed or native rollout approved through this source review.
